units.source_text: 且说六条妃子的女儿斋宫原定去年入禁中左卫门府斋戒，但因种种障碍，延至今年秋天入左卫门府。

en.t: Now, Rokujo's daughter, the Ise Priestess, had originally been scheduled to enter the Left Gate Guard Office within the palace last year for purification, but because of various obstacles, her entrance was postponed until this autumn.

units.source_text: 九月间即将移居嵯峨野宫修行，故目下正在准备第二次祓禊。

en.t: Since she was to move to the palace at Sagano in September for her religious training, preparations were now being made for the second purification ceremony.

units.source_text: 但六条妃子忽然精神失常，迷离恍惚，每日只是似睡非睡地躺着。

en.t: But Rokujo suddenly fell into a disturbed state of mind, dazed and absent, and every day she only lay there as if half asleep and half awake.

units.source_text: 她的侍女们大为震惊，为她举行种种法事，以祈祷安康。

en.t: Her ladies-in-waiting were deeply alarmed and held all kinds of Buddhist rites for her, praying for her peace and recovery.

units.source_text: 她并无何等重病，只是郁郁寡欢，沉闷度日。

en.t: She had no grave illness in particular; she was simply sunk in melancholy and passed her days in gloom.
Prince Genji often came to visit her.

units.source_text: 然而为了葵姬病重，没有关怀他事的余暇了。

en.t: However, because Lady Aoi was gravely ill, he had no leisure to concern himself with anything else.
